# Relationship input fixtures

Nine controlled JavaScript/JSX source files are parsed, never executed.

- `*.ast.json`: real native Tree-sitter JavaScript + current AstBuilder output.
- `*.metadata.json`, `*.reference.json`, `metadata-analysis.json`, `source-analysis.json`:
  generated and validated by the existing Python metadata producer and Pydantic
  project models, using its canonical identity/checksum functions.
- `*.resolution.json`, `*.resolution-reference.json`, `resolution-analysis.json`:
  generated by the current TypeScript JavascriptResolver, with its runtime validators.

Versions: AST schema 1 / syntax-preorder-v1; parser 0.25.1 / grammar 0.25.0;
metadata javascript-syntax-v1 / project-metadata-v1/javascript-syntax-v1;
resolver javascript-lexical-v1. Relationships consume these snapshots and verify
source identity, ranges, checksums and artifact identities. Tests compare snapshots
with freshly generated native ASTs and current resolver output.

Regenerate from the TypeScript repository root with existing environments:

```sh
node --import tsx src/modules/relationship-analysis/tests/generate-fixtures.mts
PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONPATH=/path/to/codeatlas-backend \
  /path/to/existing/python -B \
  src/modules/relationship-analysis/tests/generate-metadata-fixtures.py
node --import tsx src/modules/relationship-analysis/tests/generate-resolution-fixtures.mts
```

No extraction logic is copied into TypeScript. Python source is read-only and
fixture generation writes only here. Routine Vitest tests require no Python
process. `../live-integration.mts` separately starts both actual services using
explicit CODEATLAS_PYTHON_EXECUTABLE and CODEATLAS_PYTHON_REPOSITORY settings,
ephemeral loopback ports and task-owned temporary storage roots.
